mapper.sql: id, source_code, name, name_kana, operator_source_code, operator_name, color, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM railway_lines
WHERE id = #{lineId}
FOR UPDATE

SELECT operator_name
FROM railway_lines
WHERE operator_source_code = #{operatorSourceCode} AND operator_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(operator_name) != ''
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO railway_lines ( source_code, name, name_kana, operator_source_code, operator_name, color, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{line.sourceCode}, #{line.name}, #{line.nameKana}, #{line.operatorSourceCode}, #{line.operatorName}, #{line.color}, 1, #{line.sortOrder}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )

INSERT INTO rental_index_sync_tasks ( rental_id, retry_count, next_attempt_at, last_error ) SELECT DISTINCT rs.rental_id, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), NULL
FROM rental_stations rs
INNER JOIN stations s ON s.id = rs.station_id
WHERE s.line_id = #{lineId}
ORDER BY rs.rental_id
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE retry_count = 0, next_attempt_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), last_error = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
